40101402.text: Welcome back. Do you want a cup of tea?

40101403.text: How can you be so much like Wriothesley, always drinking tea...

40101404.text: Huh, actually, now that you mention it, I just remembered something now.

40101405.text: While I was sedated, I could still barely hear two people talking next to me. They were discussing everything from the leaves to the water and even the teacups themselves...

40101407.text: Yeah, I heard one male voice and one female, so it should have been the two of them. They... really were just talking about brewing tea.

40101408.text: I really can't make sense of this place...

40101409.text: #So, {NICKNAME}, Paimon... Were you able to learn anything from Wriothesley?

40101411.text: Very well... then would you mind checking your answers against my speculations?

40101414.text: Yeah, I took the time to rest, so I'm feeling a lot more relaxed now.

40101415.text: ...Nobody else is around, and Miss Sigewinne is also busy with something or other, so let's just talk here.

40101416.text: Alright. Then, I'll posit my theories. I asked myself three questions.

40101417.text: Firstly, why was Freminet affected by the Primordial Seawater? It was because he dove into the sea. My theory is... the long lost Primordial Sea is probably very close to the Fortress of Meropide.

40101418.text: Whoa, he's good! He got that right on the first try!

40101420.text: Secondly, Wriothesley's attitude changed dramatically during the course of our stay here. He ignored us completely at first, then suddenly roadblocked us. Why?

40101421.text: I spent quite a long time thinking about this. If he has been monitoring the Fatui since the very beginning, he probably ignored us at first because he was hoping we could find Master Childe for him.

40101422.text: What's more, the Fortress of Meropide is not a part of Fontaine's court system, nor does it report to Iudex Neuvillette. Wriothesley is basically the king of a no man's land.

40101423.text: As long as the Fortress doesn't do anything about Master Childe's disappearance, "Father" can use it to pressure the Fontaine authorities. And while the two factions are pitted against each other, Wriothesley will be free to move between the parties of interest.

40101424.text: If I had to guess, he probably has something that he's working on himself. It's likely related to the secret of the infirmary, but I just can't think of what it could be...

40101425.text: Lyney's grasp of the big picture is amazing.

40101427.text: Haha, thanks so much. Then finally, there's the last question.

40101428.text: If Wriothesley does have a plan, what could it be? All I know for now is that his plan probably has something to do with the changing nature of the seawater. He's even gotten Clorinde to help him out...

40101429.text: ...That can't be the full extent of what he's doing. There's probably a secret passageway behind the block in the infirmary, and there's something big in the Fortress that most people here never get to see. He has a bargaining chip, and it could be important enough for "Father" to deal with him directly.

40101430.text: I don't have enough information, so I have no idea what his chip might be. But let me guess... you have the last piece of the puzzle.

40101431.text: After some deliberation, you share the information you just learned with Lyney and company.

40101432.text: While sharing what you saw, you emphasize that now is not the time for disputes, and it's very important that they take the matter seriously and considerately.

40101434.text: The sea... will engulf everyone. Just like the prophecy said...

40101435.text: Could Wriothesley have wanted to meet "Father" to figure out a way to deal with this crisis?

40101436.text: If you remember, I once mentioned that "Father" sees the House of the Hearth as her base of operations, and she truly wants to resolve the crisis. But how could Wriothesley have known that?

40101437.text: Or perhaps, he didn't know, and just wanted to bring "Father" over to his side? Which could be why he said he just wanted to "negotiate."

40101438.text: #...Yeah, that makes sense to me. I understand your concerns as well, {NICKNAME}. I'll figure out a way to pass this on to our "Father." No matter what, we're on your side.

40101439.text: The two of you have already aided us far too much. We probably would not be standing here right now if not for you.

40101440.text: If you ever need anything else going forward, please come to the House of the Hearth at any time.

40101441.text: Though you may not share the sentiment, after all that we've gone through together, the three of us basically see you as family now.

40101443.text: Thank you for protecting Lyney when it really mattered, and thank you for sharing the secrets of the Fortress with us. We didn't think you were going to do it.

40101444.text: Why are you being so formal all of a sudden?

40101501.text: It's time for dinner. Welfare Meals now being served in the Coupon Cafeteria!

40101502.text: Come on, let's go pick up ours as well!

40101504.text: Are you here for dinner too, Miss Sigewinne?

40101505.text: Mhm, and I'm taking the opportunity to prepare Miss Clorinde's dinner as well.

40101506.text: Huh, you're right... She's actually sitting in the fortress cafeteria...

40101507.text: What would you like to eat?

40101509.text: Yep, you can! I've already talked to our chef, Mr. Wolsey. It's all on me today, so you can get whatever you'd like.

40101513.text: No problem! Just leave it to me.

40101514.text: After a while, the meals Sigewinne ordered for you arrive. Unlike days prior when you had to rely solely on luck, the dishes before you today are bursting with flavor.

40101515.text: Sigewinne also brings some drinks over to you. They taste a little strange, but she insists that they are very nutritious... She also insists that Wriothesley is also a fan of them, but neither you nor Paimon buy her claims.

40101516.text: ...Okay, the shakes genuinely taste pretty terrible. At the very least, however, they help you to calm down and relax.

40101604.text: It's alright. Miss Sigewinne really put in a lot of effort.

40101605.text: So we heard that Wriothesley invited you to come down to help and you saved Freminet, too. You sure work super fast.

40101607.text: Still, Paimon didn't know even Champion Duelists could take on side jobs...

40101608.text: Oh and, why aren't you eating with Sigewinne and the Duke? Won't you get bored eating by yourself?

40101609.text: Miss Sigewinne was with you, and the Duke has business of his own.

40101610.text: Hm... Actually, didn't Navia say that you went out for dinner with her as well?

40101611.text: Yeah. First time in a long time.

40101612.text: "First time in a long time"? So you mean, you've gone out to dinner with her in the past?

40101614.text: You seem to be enjoying yourselves here.

40101617.text: Things will be getting messy at the Fortress soon. Don't run around unnecessarily.

subQuests.subQuestName: Return to the dormitories to rest

40100101.text: Ugh... So much has happened, Paimon just feels absolutely exhausted now that she's finally relaxed...

40100102.text: Paimon's super sleepy... Are you sleepy, too...?

40100106.text: Hmm... Delicious... Paimon wants seconds... For free!

40100201.text: What happened, why is everyone running around... Hey! What are you doing?

40100202.text: No time to explain, mate! Goodbye!

40100204.text: What's wrong with these people!? They won't even talk to us!

40100205.text: They're here! Ah, there you are!

40100207.text: Cuistot and Laverune? Do you know what happened here?

40100208.text: We came here especially to inform you! Something seems to have gone terribly wrong just now, His Grace is telling everyone to evacuate and get out of here.

40100209.text: Laverune was saying, you two are new here, and don't have many friends, so you might slip through the cracks. Haven't you heard of stories like that? An evacuation is successfully completed, yet you only find out once you do a headcount that one or two people are missing...

40100210.text: Wait, weren't you the one who brought that up? Why is it suddenly my idea?

40100212.text: Okay, whatever. The point is, you should come with us.

40100213.text: You said His Grace said to... evacuate "outwards"?

40100214.text: Yeah, he said to get as far away as possible, upwards and outwards.

40100215.text: (Then that means whatever happened must have happened down below... Oh no, isn't that gate at the very bottom!?)

40100216.text: Oh no, it can't be that thing!

40100217.text: What? Hey! Where are you going!?

40100218.text: We have to go find the Duke! You two, just go and get out! Go on without us!

40100301.text: Alright. Seems like the problem inside has been suppressed.

40100302.text: Let me guess, we're safe for now?

40100304.text: I win this bet. You owe me a present.

40100305.text: Very well, it was indeed just as you said.

40100307.text: We made a bet on the size of your entourage. Clorinde thought you wouldn't come down by yourself.

40100308.text: I figured you would have at least brought a few people along for appearances' sake. It appears I underestimated just how confidential the mission was.

40100309.text: Shouldn't you have gotten used to confidential missions by now? That's just how the courts operate.

40100310.text: So... what gift must the loser give? Tea?

40100311.text: He already has tons of tea in his office. I'm thinking about a set of legal codices.

40100312.text: That wouldn't happen to be a dig at my lack of legal awareness, would it...

40100313.text: Well, I'm sure His Grace doesn't consider the Fortress to be outside the law.

40100314.text: I was under the impression the residents of a place like this would be uninterested in the legal codices...

40100315.text: Uh, that was obviously a joke.

40100316.text: Anyway, you've still got some unfinished business to attend to in the overworld, correct?

40100317.text: No need to stay here if you have a pressing matter. We all know you can't leave Palais Mermonia for long.

40100319.text: (I hope everything went smoothly with the Fatui Harbinger.)

40100602.text: #{NICKNAME}, I need you to head to the opera house immediately.

40100603.text: Furina will soon be meeting with The Knave there. You must protect Furina and make sure she doesn't spend too much time alone with her.

40100604.text: Okay, you can explain everything else to me later!

40100605.text: Will do. You have my sincerest gratitude.

40100701.text: Look, there are a ton of Fatui and Palais Mermonia people over there! The Knave is probably here already... We need to hurry!

40100702.text: #Are you two {NICKNAME} and Paimon? Monsieur Neuvillette has left instructions. Please follow me.

40100703.text: Though I'm sure he's already explained, this should be a mostly cordial conversation unlikely to give rise to violence, but it would be most appreciated if you could protect Lady Furina to the best of your abilities.

40100801.text: Oh, so you two are the honored guests Miss Furina mentioned.

40100802.text: Of course, of course! How could they not attend a meeting such as this? I must always have two or more guests at my dessert table, otherwise the occasion would be too lonely and unbecoming of my station.

40100803.text: #It is my pleasure to make your acquaintance, {NICKNAME}, I have heard much of your accomplishments. I am The Knave, one of the eleven Fatui Harbingers.

40100804.text: (So this is The Knave... the head of the House of the Hearth, and the Lyney siblings' "Father." She certainly does not seem easy to deal with.)

40100807.text: I've already prepared seats for you. Come, sit beside me.

40100808.text: Perhaps you two are unaware of how Miss Furina and I do things. You see, we actually recently agreed to get together for tea when we had the time.

40100809.text: See this? This is a limited type of confectionery that Miss Furina simply adores. There are only sixteen slices sold every day. Here, why don't you and Paimon have a taste?

40100810.text: (She seems friendly enough, but that can't be all there is to her... The Knave is a force to be reckoned with. I should be very cautious around her.)

40100811.text: #{NICKNAME}, what do you think of this cake?

subQuests.subQuestName: Continue taking part in the tea party

40100901.text: *sigh* I must say, we've spent long enough playing house.

40100902.text: Miss Furina. As the Hydro Archon, I am sure you understand the exact meaning of the phenomenon we just witnessed. Or should I say, that's what I originally thought, but looking at your expression... was I wrong, and you haven't a clue?

40100904.text: At this point, I don't think there's any more need to speak as diplomatic representatives. Allow me to speak to you now as just a Fontainian: You know the prophecy by heart, and also that every part of it is being proven true.

40100905.text: Yet here you are relaxing, drinking tea and eating desserts as if it's all nothing more than a few stray bugs in your garden. Do you really think that's acceptable?

40100906.text: The prophecy's hanging above our necks like a guillotine. Every faction is looking for a way to either avert the disaster or save their own. Even the orphans of the House of the Hearth have devoted everything to saving their homeland.

40100907.text: But you? It beggars belief just how nonchalant and carefree you have been. From the very beginning, you, the god Focalors... You have utterly failed to take action.

40100908.text: You're wrong... I've never ignored the prophecy, nor have I just been passing the time in self-indulgence. Retract your accusation, and stop doubting the wisdom of the gods with such absurd conjectures!

40100909.text: I am not alone in my doubts, you know. All the children of Fontaine may be harboring the exact same thoughts right now.

40100910.text: O great Hydro Archon, how are you going to save them? Save us? How are the people you've sworn to protect supposed to survive in a land that will soon disappear beneath the waves?

40100911.text: I have my ways, and I've been working on them for all this time... Even if you look down upon me, you have no right to judge me!

40100912.text: Fontaine will be saved. Even... Even if I still cannot see the true future right now, as long as I continue on as I am, I will be able to hold my head up high!

40100913.text: (Furina's not acting like her usual self. She's actually seriously refuting The Knave's accusations... She means what she says. She's not putting on a front.)

40100914.text: Then I ask you, Miss Furina, just what have you been working on? Where can we see it, and what is it doing to help?

40100916.text: (...So was that all a lie? Or can she really not tell us? She was so full of conviction and confidence just now, but now she's deflated like a popped balloon.)

40100917.text: ...My machinations are just like the prophecy itself — they will only reveal themselves at the fated time. It is just that beings like yourselves are unable to perceive them as of yet.

40100918.text: I see. As a god, the proof of your labor always lies beyond prying mortal eyes.

40100919.text: Allow me to be so bold as to ask another way. Would it be possible for you to tell us the parts of your plan that are not confidential? Such as... your emergency response plan for the impending disaster.

40100921.text: Ah, that look in your eyes... Have you not even prepared one of those?

40100922.text: The... The emergency response plan is also strictly confidential.

40100923.text: Then allow me to jog your memory. Miss Furina, what is the purpose of your Oratrice Mecanique d'Analyse Cardinale?

40100924.text: And what do you plan to do with the massive amounts of Indemnitium that it has accumulated over the years?

40100925.text: Th—The Oratrice? It... It's just like it appears to be...

40100926.text: Hmph, so you also have no idea? If I'm not mistaken, someone's using it to prepare for something. But unfortunately, it would seem that someone is not you, Miss Furina.

40100927.text: I first caught wind of this when Lyney tried to investigate the Oratrice in the opera house. You see, even just getting close to the core contaminated him with an extremely large amount of Indemnitium.

40100928.text: But if even that had nothing to do with you... Then what could you possibly be working on, O great Hydro Archon?

40100929.text: Oh, right, I almost forgot. Iudex Neuvillette is not at the tea party with us today. Miss Furina, I suppose you must have ordered him away to take care of some troublesome business.

40100930.text: Ah, yeah, yes, that's exactly right! Please keep it a secret for me.

40100931.text: Of course I will. Although I must say, Miss Furina, you seem quite insecure without the Iudex by your side.

40100932.text: Very well, let's stop that conversation here. There are still a few slices of cake left, so please help yourselves, everyone.

40100933.text: (These aren't topics I can speak about... I don't even know what Neuvillette's task was.)

40100934.text: (If I had to guess, he probably went down to deal with the surging Primordial Sea... But can he really deal with it all by himself?)

40100935.text: (And is Furina being truthful or not?)

40100936.text: #{NICKNAME}, I heard that you were recently commissioned to handle a few matters on behalf of the Iudex. Why don't you take an extra slice of cake? Those who work hard deserve gratitude and praise.

40100938.text: Er... Thank you, Paimon will take you up on that offer...

40100939.text: The Knave proceeds to change the topic and brings up a number of less significant matters. While the atmosphere gradually becomes more relaxed, the somber feeling from the prior conversation remains in everyone's hearts.

40100940.text: Ah! Paimon's super full. That cake was great!

40100941.text: Mhm-mmm, if it's on my tea table, it must be of the highest quality. Ah, yes, and we must thank The Knave for bringing these over as well.

40100942.text: You're welcome. I'm sure the cake also felt greatly honored to be featured at Miss Furina's table. And I was merely catering to Miss Furina's tastes, seeking a chance to chat over tea.

40100943.text: It is getting late. Why don't we call it a day? There are still a few matters that I need to take care of, so I must take my leave now.

40100944.text: Very well, we'll end it here.

40100945.text: #Mind seeing me off, {NICKNAME}? We could use the opportunity to discuss Childe before I must be on my way.

subQuests.subQuestName: Follow The Knave to the exit

40101001.text: I'm glad that you were willing to come with me. Of course, Childe was just an excuse. I have no interest in your dealings with him.

40101003.text: What do you want to say?

40101004.text: You lent your aid to the children of the House of the Hearth. As their "Father," I would like to express my gratitude.

40101008.text: Was there nothing else you wanted to say?

40101009.text: That was all. Formal topics should be discussed in formal settings, and informal topics in informal settings.

40101010.text: I know you just returned from the Fortress of Meropide. Relax, I have no intention of trying to get anything out of you. Lyney, Lynette and Freminet are still there, and I trust their judgment and abilities.

40101011.text: They've all been working very hard, and have always done all they can to fight back against anyone who tried to stop them! Especially Lyney...

40101012.text: You mean Wriothesley. He's a tricky one to deal with. It's unfortunate that Lyney's so eager to prove himself that he can't learn to rely on others... including me.

40101013.text: By the way, and you can just consider this a bit of idle gossip, but what's your impression of Furina?

40101015.text: You are outside of our disputes, and the freest person in all of Fontaine, able to move around most easily. Allow me to share my perspective with you.

40101016.text: ...And that's everything that happened during the trial. Master Childe was declared guilty, and immediately transported to the Fortress of Meropide.

40101017.text: Didn't he say he was coming here on vacation? Does he not feel an ounce of shame for all the trouble he has caused?

40101019.text: Forget it. He did give us an opportunity.

40101020.text: I will be meeting someone shortly.

40101021.text: Do you require help with any preparations?

40101022.text: No need. I will take care of it myself.

40101023.text: (I need to meet with Furina, the Hydro Archon. She is at the heart of Fontaine, but what's fascinating about her is that, she often seems more like a celebrity than a working Archon.)

40101024.text: Oh? Come over here, you little critter you!

40101026.text: You dare to run from me? Stop right this instant!

40101027.text: (My goal is just to discover the location of the Gnosis, but I didn't expect the chance to approach Furina to be handed to me on a silver platter. This is so easy, it's actually making me a bit suspicious...)

40101028.text: (Anything left unguarded is usually just bait. But no one will blame someone for taking the bait. After all, from the moment it was attached to the hook, the bait is meant to be sacrificed.)

40101030.text: (It's just as I guessed in the second before I struck. The Hydro Gnosis is not currently held by the Archon...)

40101049.text: (In fact, this "archon" doesn't seem like a god at all... And I sense that she's under some kind of curse...)

40101031.text: Who are you? A—And wh—what are you trying to do? Please don't kill me, I'm begging you, please...

40101032.text: (The fear in her pupils is genuine, so perhaps she is not bait after all. Either way, targeting her has lost all meaning.)

40101034.text: (I left the scene with ease. Nobody came looking for me, and nobody could serve as a witness to my near-assassination of Focalors. I suspect even Furina dares not mention this incident to anyone.)

40101035.text: (Not long after, my informants confirmed what I had guessed: After returning to her quarters, Furina quietly cried alone. She was so scared that she could not sleep that night, nor could she even bring herself to eat her cake.)

40101036.text: (There's no doubt that there's something wrong with her. I began to entertain the possibility that she is not the true Hydro Archon — perhaps Iudex Neuvillette is actually the genuine article.)

40101037.text: (I have to find the Gnosis. If the Neuvillette hypothesis is correct, he is probably in possession of it. Alternatively, it might have been hidden in a place that's hard for ordinary people to access.)

40101040.text: News from the Fortress of Meropide. Master... Master Childe has gone missing. On top of that, the contacts and guards we bribed at the Fortress have all gone quiet as well...

40101043.text: This is a good opportunity. The value of a Harbinger is much higher than most would imagine. We now have an excuse to exert diplomatic pressure on the Fontaine authorities.

40101044.text: Set up a meeting for me. I would like to meet the Hydro Archon and Iudex Neuvillette.

40101045.text: Oh, and I have an additional mission for you three.

40101047.text: (Tartaglia's disappearance was not a part of my plan, but I can use it to make a breakthrough. With this as my excuse, I can ask for an official audience, and continue my investigation of Furina and Iudex Neuvillette.)

40101048.text: (The initiative belongs to the House of the Hearth. My wish to investigate the Fortress of Meropide will be a front. Lyney and his group will be responsible for the actual intelligence-gathering.)

40101007.text: Do I look like an irresponsible "Father" to you? Hehe, the House of the Hearth is very important to me. You should know that I care deeply about my children.

40101101.text: You should know the rest. Lyney's group is quite close to you, so they wouldn't have hidden anything from you.

40101103.text: It wouldn't mean anything even if you shouted it from the rooftops. After all, even Furina herself is still pretending that nothing of that sort ever happened.

40101105.text: I've now had two chances to enjoy tea with Furina. I have to say, the leadership of Fontaine is even more inscrutable than I had imagined. I once surmised that Iudex Neuvillette must be the Hydro Archon, but now, that doesn't seem right to me either.

40101106.text: How did you come to that conclusion?

40101107.text: I am a servant of Her Majesty the Tsaritsa. Over my years of service, I've learned how a real Archon conducts and carries themselves. Whether Iudex Neuvillette or Furina, neither fits the bill. It's hard to imagine either of them as the Archon.

40101108.text: Of course, that is all just how I feel. Gut feelings often do not require justification.

40101109.text: It is, however, quite amusing to me that after all my years working in intelligence gathering, I've come to realize I am at a complete loss regarding the identity of the god of the land of my birth.

40101110.text: Don't you think Fontaine is quite intriguing? A catastrophe looms, yet many secrets have yet to rise to the surface. It looks like Fontainians will have no choice but to save themselves.

40101111.text: Ultimately, though, one must survive in order to do anything else. Should the need arise, I would be happy to cooperate with you.

40101112.text: You don't need to commit to anything right now, of course. I have a feeling that the situation will continue to evolve. And as your name is often connected with noble deeds, I'm sure we will work together someday.

40101114.text: He certainly returned quickly. You must want to catch up with each other, so I'll leave you to him.

40101117.text: For now, yes, but this issue will prove quite thorny in the long term. I am concerned that sooner or later, the prophesized events will occur...

40101119.text: May we ask what happened down there?

40101120.text: Mmm... To put it simply, I used my power to force back the Primordial Sea and re-seal the sluice gate.

40101121.text: As for what happened on our side...

40101122.text: You recount the happenings of the tea party to Neuvillette...

40101123.text: ...So, as expected, The Knave has turned up the pressure on Furina. She's trying to feel her out, though I'm still unsure as to her motives.

40101124.text: Can I ask you some questions?

40101128.text: Whoa, it can't be that you're the real Hydro Archon, right? But that's just a speculation on our part, though...

40101130.text: You can't tell us? Then... Then that's okay, we can talk about something else, we won't try to force you... Hahaha, you guys in Fontaine are super strange...

40101131.text: If by the phrase "you guys" you are referring to Furina and I, then although I'm not sure just what you are trying to imply, I must clarify that I do not share her positions on a multitude of topics.

40102401.text: I feel like... I should try to become someone more capable of helping.

40102402.text: You're incredibly helpful. Lyney thinks so too.

40102403.text: Yeah. You two are always telling me not to push myself, but aren't you just like that as well?

40102502.text: His Grace has already given the order to evacuate. Please leave the area in an orderly fashion, and watch your step!

40102503.text: (No, I have to go to the forbidden zone right away to check on the situation there.)

40102601.text: His Grace has asked everyone to evacuate outwards as quickly as possible. You should get a move on.

40102701.text: ...The tea party turned out to be even more difficult than I'd imagined...

40102702.text: Huh? Ah... Ahem! Why are you looking at me like that? Is something the matter? If there's nothing urgent, then I shall be retiring for now.

40109901.text: Attention! Please evacuate upwards and outwards, upwards and outwards! If you're already at the topmost layer, then try to move as far outwards as possible!
